description.en: Role-based model routing for DeepSeek Harness: the planner (root agent) runs on deepseek-v4-pro, delegated executor subagents run on deepseek-v4-flash; ships a prompt section and a pro-flash-routing skill.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 角色化模型路由：规划者（根 Agent）运行 deepseek-v4-pro，委派执行子 Agent 运行 deepseek-v4-flash；附带提示词区块与 pro-flash-routing 技能。
